## Checklist

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run verify` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run lint` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run audit` and dependency/signature audits succeed
- [ ] `npm run package:check` contains only the approved package surface
- [ ] No credential, private path, provider API key, custom OAuth, or lifecycle script was added
- [ ] DSH/provider version changes include compatibility evidence
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests and documentation
